conversions.label: Speed
conversions.help: Set the pace of the original speech. Above 1 gives less speaking time; below 1 gives more. No separate speed edit is used.
conversions.instruction: Adjust the speech speed to {value}x.

conversions.label: Volume
conversions.help: Use a positive number to make the voice louder, or a negative number to make it quieter. The exact loudness change may vary.
conversions.instruction: {direction} the volume by {magnitude} dB, keeping the same voice.

conversions.label: Pitch
conversions.help: Raise or lower the voice in semitones. Positive values raise it; negative values lower it. The exact pitch change may vary.
conversions.instruction: {direction} the pitch by {magnitude} semitones, keeping the same voice.

conversions.label: Enhance speech
conversions.help: Ask for clearer speech with less background noise and room echo.
conversions.instruction: Preserve all speakers, remove noise and reverberation, and output clean speech of the same length.

conversions.label: Remove noise
conversions.help: Reduce background noise while keeping the voice and other details.
conversions.instruction: Remove only the background noise, preserve everything else, and output audio of the same length.

conversions.label: Remove room echo
conversions.help: Reduce room echo while keeping the words and voice.
conversions.instruction: Remove only the room reverberation, preserve everything else, and output audio of the same length.

conversions.label: Repair quality
conversions.help: Describe the unwanted recording effect, such as a telephone effect or muffled sound.
conversions.instruction: Repair the {value} and restore natural, clear speech, keeping the same voice.

categories.Emotion: Choose the feeling in the original spoken line.
categories.Delivery: Choose how the original line is spoken.
categories.Expressive delivery: Choose an expressive way of speaking the original line.
categories.Voice: Change the finished line's delivery, emotion, or voice quality.
categories.Sounds: Add a sound at the beginning of the line.
categories.Removal: Remove an unwanted sound from the line.
categories.Acoustics: Adjust speaking speed, loudness, or pitch.
categories.Cleanup: Reduce noise, echo, or an unwanted recording effect.

help.style: Choose the starting tone for this line. Use conversions or inline edits for further changes.
help.conversion: Add a change to this line's audio. Changes are applied in the order shown.
help.duration: Sets the length of the original spoken line. Speed changes and added sounds may change the final length.
help.rate: Estimates the length of lines without a duration. Higher values allow less time for the same words.
help.extra: Allows additional time for each laugh, cough, or other sound you add.
help.connected: Edit the connected text node to change this script.
help.script: Write one spoken line per row. Start with one optional voice style and any conversions. End with (3s) to choose the original length.
help.seed: Keep this number and choose fixed to repeat the same random choices. Change it to try a different performance.
help.steps: Controls how much refinement is used. Start with 32. More can take longer; Flash chooses its own setting.
help.guidance: Controls how strongly the voice follows your request. Start with 2. Flash chooses its own setting.
help.sway: Fine-tunes how the sound is refined. Leave at -1 unless you want to experiment. Flash chooses its own setting.
help.inline: Select words to change their delivery or add a sound before them. Turn off to speak the words without these changes.
help.review: Generate all lines and send the recording onward. Browse, regenerate, or add lines here, then Finalize to send your revised recording.
